ruleDefinitions.name: Potential NTLM Coercion Via Certutil.EXE
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects possible NTLM coercion via certutil using the 'syncwithWU' flag

sequences.query: ((process_path = RGX("\\\\certutil\\\.exe$") OR process_original_file_name = "CertUtil\.exe") AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-syncwithWU\\ .*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\\\\\\\.*")))
